opening.argument: The opportunity is presented as a way to put Bitcoin to work for passive, recurring income: the speaker says, “my money is continuing to work for me” and that “as long as you're making Bitcoin daily you are doing well with this opportunity.” The promised returns are then quantified by balance, with “ten dollars a day” at one thousand dollars and “a hundred dollars a day” at ten thousand dollars. This is not neutral financial commentary: viewers are offered an invitation to participate in an opportunity framed as passive income, making the communication an active solicitation supported by claimed earnings and bonuses.
